artifact_channel: GPFS container writes were not visible from the login node. A separate bounded file roundtrip through rjob download-logs followed by SSH/SCP was verified in knowledge/vcc25/evidence/gears-checkpoint-roundtrip-20261006.json.
conclusion: The GPFS path is not a cross-environment persistence channel. rjob download-logs can return bounded artifacts when they are chunked, throttled, and checksum-verified; it is not yet established as a scalable general checkpoint store.
